name: portfolio
description: Mohamed Moheyeldin's unified portfolio and resume platform.

scripts.build:cloudflare: astro check && cross-env SITE_URL=https://mohamedmoheyeldin.com astro build
scripts.build:pages: astro check && cross-env SITE_URL=https://mohamedmoheyeldin.github.io BASE_PATH=/portfolio astro build
scripts.build:sites: astro check && cross-env SITE_URL=https://mohamedmoheyeldin.com astro build && node scripts/stage-sites.mjs
scripts.preview:test: node scripts/ensure-build.mjs && cross-env ASTRO_PREVIEW_BACKGROUND=0 astro preview --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.quality: pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm test:e2e:cypress && pnpm test:pages
